title: pavo v1 driver manifest
description: What a tamias-driver-<type> executable answers to the `manifest` verb. Mirrors crates/pavo-protocol/src/manifest.rs. Additive-only within v1.

name.description: Driver name — the <type> in tamias-driver-<type>; namespaces routes as /<name>/<view>.

icon.description: Optional icon — emoji, icon name, or renderer-resolvable path.

verbs.description: Wire verbs beyond the tamias install verbs — e.g. ["manifest", "serve"].

deps.description: Driver dependency declarations — names are driver names (the <type> in tamias-driver-<type>). `requires` absent = discovery error; `optional` absent = degrade gracefully. Ordering/topo-sort is a later host phase; v1 carries the declaration only.

renderers.description: View-kind renderer declarations — the driver doubles as a renderer plugin. A driver may declare renderers with zero views (renderer-only). See protocol/v1/README.md#renderer-plugins.

contributes.description: Contribution slots — navbar, dashboard, statusbar, routes, sidebar, headerActions, notifications, jobs, plus forward-compat extras.

sidebar.description: Grouped nav entries for a left sidebar shell; hosts may cluster later. Same Contribution shape as other slots.

headerActions.description: Top-bar actions; `route` points at the view the host renders in a popover/panel.

notifications.description: Marks the driver as a notification provider — display metadata only; item data comes via the `notifications` wire op (NotificationItem).

jobs.description: Marks the driver as a job/queue feed provider — display metadata only; item data comes via the `jobs` wire op (JobItem).

route.description: Host-relative route the entry navigates to.

priority.description: Ordering hint within the slot; lower sorts first.

id.description: View id, unique within the driver.

route.description: Route the view answers — <driver>:<view> deep links resolve here.

id.description: Renderer id, unique within the driver — namespaced as <driver>:<id> in listings.

kinds.description: ViewNode kinds this renderer claims (e.g. ["graph"]), or ["*"] for a catch-all. Explicit kinds beat "*"; lowest priority wins conflicts; ties break by driver name then renderer id.

priority.description: Conflict-resolution priority — lower wins (mirrors chrome contribution policy).

entry.description: Optional hint naming the renderer entry point (documentation/tooling only — routing is by kinds+surfaces).

rendererSurfaces.description: Which surfaces this renderer supports. Absent surface = unsupported there.

formats.description: CLI --format values this renderer handles (e.g. ["svg","ascii"]). Empty = wildcard: claims every format including text. Built-in formats text/json/dot/mermaid stay available as fallback when unclaimed.

component.description: v2 hint — dynamic-import/placeholder component name; v1 renders the RenderModel generically.

island.description: Renderer emits self-contained markup (e.g. svg) safe to embed as a web island.

driverDeps.description: Driver dependency declarations (mirrors requiredDeps/optionalDeps semantics). `requires` entries missing at discovery = error; `optional` entries missing = degrade gracefully.

requires.description: Driver names this driver cannot function without — absence is a discovery error.

optional.description: Driver names this driver uses when present — absence degrades gracefully.

name.description: Binding name — referenced by `query` fields in the tree.

op.description: Wire op to invoke on the driver's serve.

driver.description: Optional target driver for cross-driver queries — names the driver (the <type> in tamias-driver-<type>) whose serve answers the op. Host-side resolution is a later phase; absent = the view's own driver.

params.description: Static params merged into every invocation.
